page.layout: One column of running text, with small marginal notes in the right margin, mostly overlapping the text edge and largely illegible. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Signature mark at the foot.

main_text.p: suos curarent, delinquentesque puni-rent: puniti vero si querelas hac de re ad patres deferrent, turpe esset patri-bus, non alia porrò verba querenti-bus irrogare: omnisque adeò puero-rum ἀγωγὴ[?] ad discendum promptum obsequium, ad sufferendos quoslibet labores & dolores, ad parandas in cer-taminibus & proeliis victorias refere-batur. Quem in finem tondebantur cute tenus, & discalceati incedebant à primis pueritiæ annis, & nudi inter se summâ contentione decertabant. Omnium verò duriffimum hoc erat magno autorum veterum confensu me-[?][illegible, ~6 letters]moriæ proditum, quòd pueri non è vul-go solum, sed etiam nobiles ad ar-[illegible, ~4 letters]Dianæ Tauricæ, (ea cum fano erat[illegible, ~3 letters] ipsa urbe,in vico Limnæo,)cui sacra[illegible, ~4 letters]ri sine sanguine fas non esse credeba-tur, quotannis stato die flagellis gravi-ter cæderentur, ut sanguis copiose[illegible, ~3 letters] membris defflueret, præsentibus spe-ctantibusq; ipsorum parentibus ac pro-[illegible, ~3 letters]pinquis, & ad tolerantiam eos exhor-tantibus: idque quadam æmulatione mutua, & gloriæ cupidine tam pa-[illegible, ~3 letters]tienter ipsi ferrent, (gloriosum en-putabatur, alios tolerantiâ superare,[illegible, ~3 letters]ne gemerent quidem, ac sæpenumero[illegible, ~3 letters]ad mortem usque hilares & gestientes

page.notes: Right-margin notes are printed over the text edge and are almost entirely unreadable; they are marked as illegible at their approximate positions. "me-[?]" at the line end is hidden by a marginal note; the word is most likely "memoriæ", continued as "moriæ" on the next line. "ἀγωγὴ[?]" is uncertain in its accent. "copiose" is partly obscured by the margin. Left-edge marks and red scan border are not printed text and are omitted.
